subject: Private deployment addendum: operator access approach & deposit path
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@medivalue.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@medivalue.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment — addendum coverage and continuity deposit 

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we scope the Private deployment for MediValue we need to align the legal packaging early so procurement can sign the order form next month. Two items we need explicit language for in an MSA addendum / order form exhibit: 1) License residency and runtime rights for the deployed model artifacts (on-prem/VPC), and 2) a continuity deposit mechanism so we have a minimal recovery path if Redwood is unavailable (we are not asking for source code — just a sealed snapshot and a signed operator runbook we can invoke with a third-party witness).

Specifically: can Redwood commit to a limited, escrow-like sealed snapshot (encrypted, sealed to customer public key, held by a neutral custodian) with access only under a very narrow trigger (insolvency or material breach)? We also need the audit window language and a list of evidence items your team can provide during a standard audit (logs, witness checks, runbooks).

Can you share a proposed addendum draft and a short mutual action plan (timeline + owners)? Also please confirm whether the Order Form needs a reserved-capacity SKU change for the operator-only access path.

Appreciate a short reply with next steps — procurement is targeting signing by 2/15.

Thanks,
Sana Patel
VP, Procurement
MediValue Health

Attachments: none

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@medivalue.com>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@medivalue.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment — addendum coverage and continuity deposit

Thanks Sana — appreciate the clear asks. High-level response and next steps below, then I'll loop legal and compliance into the draft.

Summary (short):
- Redwood can offer a sealed-snapshot deposit model (encrypted to your public key) and a witness-lite retrieval pathway under narrow triggers (insolvency or court-ordered transfer). We call this a "sealed artifact deposit" rather than full escrow.
- We will not deposit source code; deliverable is a runtime snapshot + operator runbook + cryptographic attestations. Access is gated by a multistep verification process.
- Audit/evidence: we can commit to a standard evidence bundle (system logs, KV cache export summary, runbook acceptance test results, connectivity proofs) and a 4-hr on-call window for a pre-scheduled audit.
- Commercial: sealed-deposit handling is an order-form exhibit (one-time fee) and we will need to tag the Order Form with the reserved-capacity SKU you selected. Karthik, I'll need your confirmation on pricing delta.

Attachments I'm sharing now: MSA_Addendum_PrivateDeployment_v1_redline.docx (initial language to cover sealed deposit, triggers, and limited forensics access), OrderForm_MediValue_capacity_with_notes.pdf (notes on SKU and one-time handling fee), and KMS_Integration_Spec_Summary.pdf (what we need from your infra team to lock the sealed snapshot to your key).

Proposed timeline (mutual action plan):
- This week (1/12-1/15): Legal review of attached addendum (Redwood + MediValue) and confirm any material policy conflicts.
- Week of 1/18: Redwood legal to provide refined redlines (if any).
- Week of 1/25: Finalize order form pricing/fee and circulate DocuSign.
- Target sign by 2/15 and delivery window for sandbox readiness by 3/1.

Ask for MediValue: please confirm procurement point-of-contact for the order-form questions and provide the public key for the sealed snapshot KMS envelope (or we can accept a Redwood KMS wrap and transfer key material via your KMS).

Karthik, David, Neha — can you review the attached and flag anything that is an immediate no-go? If legal signs off on staged retrieval semantics, I'll schedule a short call 1/14 to discuss operational triggers and custody steward selection.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_Addendum_PrivateDeployment_v1_redline.docx; OrderForm_MediValue_capacity_with_notes.pdf; KMS_Integration_Spec_Summary.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.patel@medivalue.com>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@medivalue.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment — addendum coverage and continuity deposit

Thanks Steph / Sana — quick commercial notes from my side:
- We can accommodate the sealed deposit as a one-time professional services line item + custodian fees. I'd propose a fixed fee for the deposit and an annual safe-keeping charge.
- For the Order Form: the reserved-capacity SKU in your draft will need a small uplift if you require a daytime witness window for retrieval testing or forensics exercises. If MediValue is okay with a quarterly witness exercise instead of an on-demand test, we can keep the uplift minimal.
- Please confirm whether geofencing (US-only residency) is required; that can affect pricing and the custody options for the sealed snapshot.

Inline suggestion to MSA addendum (high level):
- Define "Sealed Artifact Deposit" with a trigger set limited to: (a) Redwood insolvency; (b) Redwood material breach and failure to cure in 60 days; (c) court order. Access process requires: (i) signed declaration by customer counsel; (ii) custodian verification; (iii) Redwood legal notification window (48h) unless court order supersedes.

If MediValue accepts that framing we can push legal redlines forward. I'm copying David for the exact indemnity and handoff language.

Karthik
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@medivalue.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment — addendum coverage and continuity deposit

Sana / Team — following internal review, attaching a clean redline and summary comments (see attached MSA_Addendum_PrivateDeployment_v1_redline.docx). Key legal positions and proposed language summary below.

1) Sealed Artifact Deposit: Redwood will accept a sealed snapshot deposit model if the following conditions are met: (i) deposit is encrypted to the customer public key and deposited with an independent custodian approved by both parties; (ii) Redwood retains the right to validate authenticity through cryptographic attestation; (iii) retrieval only permitted upon the narrow triggers proposed by Karthik.

2) Limited Forensics Access: We will provide a curated evidence bundle for audit events (logs, runbook test artifacts, configuration manifest). Full live operator access or credentials transfer is not part of the deposit. Customer may engage an approved third-party witness to observe retrieval and acceptance tests.

3) Indemnity & Liability: We propose a limited liability carveout tied to willful misconduct; Redwood does not accept broad indemnity for downstream uses of model outputs post-retrieval. We added a step for a short dispute resolution window (30 days) prior to retrieval where governance allows.

4) Order Form: We included a one-time Handling & Custody Fee line and an optional Annual Safe-Keeping Fee. Pricing note: if MediValue requires quarterly witness exercises, add a recurring testing fee. Karthik, please confirm the commercial numbers and I'll bake them into the DocuSign-ready exhibit.

Next steps:
- Sana: please confirm custodian nomination and whether MediValue will provide a KMS public key OR prefers Redwood-managed KMS wrap + key escrow transfer.
- Sana / Tom: review the attached redline and flag material objections by 1/22.
- If no material objections, we will prepare the DocuSign envelope (link below) for the Order Form + Addendum and target signing the addendum with the Order Form by 2/15 as Stephanie outlined.

DocuSign envelope (prep): https://na1-docusign.redwood.com/envelope/EV-9842-MV 

David Kim
Senior Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_Addendum_PrivateDeployment_v1_redline.docx
